title: BUG: the replayed Phoenix is a new object — the 5 damage from Sky Splitter is cleared by the trash round-trip (124.1)

repro.testName: BUG: the replayed Phoenix is a new object — the 5 damage from Sky Splitter is cleared by the trash round-trip (124.1)

history.note: Root cause found: damage is mirrored into meta.__counters.damage and harness card-state.ts takes max(meta.damage, meta.__counters.damage); the SBA death wipe in cleanup/state-based-checks.ts (and its clearDamage helper) zero only meta.damage + the counter store, so a trash round-trip keeps 5. Patch (clearDamage also writing __counters:{...,damage:0} + calling it from the death wipe) makes the test pass in isolation on a clean HEAD worktree, but the same test still fails under the FULL engine-suite run — order-dependent global state outside this change — so land-patch blocks. Reverted; needs the ordering pollution diagnosed first.
